dropped.1: Pre-release: TRANSCRIBING_PLACEHOLDER moved to @alexkroman1/aai-ui/internal. It is a tuning constant referenced by no public signature and named by no file outside this package, so it sat in a client.tsx author's autocomplete beside useSession while being a framework decision with no field to set.

Pre-release: DEFAULT_PROGRESS_POLL_MS, DEFAULT_WORKFLOW_POLL_MS and MAX_MISSING_READS moved to @alexkroman1/aai-ui/internal.
